ayahs.arabicText: وَ الطُّوْرِۙ
ayahs.translation: By the Mount,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كِتٰبٍ مَّسْطُوْرٍۙ
ayahs.translation: and the Book inscribed

ayahs.arabicText: فِیْ رَقٍّ مَّنْشُوْرٍۙ
ayahs.translation: on fine parchment;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ الْبَیْتِ الْمَعْمُوْرِۙ
ayahs.translation: by the much-frequented House,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ السَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوْعِۙ
ayahs.translation: by the elevated canopy;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُوْرِۙ
ayahs.translation: and by the swelling sea:

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌۙ
ayahs.translation: verily your Lord's chastisement shall come to pass,

ayahs.arabicText: مَّا لَهٗ مِنْ دَافِعٍۙ
ayahs.translation: none can avert that.

ayahs.arabicText: یَّوْمَ تَمُوْرُ السَّمَآءُ مَوْرًاۙ
ayahs.translation: (It shall come to pass) on the Day when the heaven will convulse in a great convulsion,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ تَسِیْرُ الْجِبَالُ سَیْرًاؕ
ayahs.translation: and the mountains shall violently fly about.

ayahs.arabicText: فَوَیْلٌ یَّوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Woe, then, on that Day to those who give the lie (to this Message)

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ فِیْ خَوْضٍ یَّلْعَبُوْنَۘ
ayahs.translation: and amuse themselves with vain argumentation.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ یُدَعُّوْنَ اِلٰى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّاؕ
ayahs.translation: On the Day when they shall be thrust into Hell with a violent thrust (and shall be told):

ayahs.arabicText: هٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِیْ كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: “This is the Hell which you used to give the lie to.”

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَسِحْرٌ هٰذَاۤ اَمْ اَنْتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Is this, then, any feat of magic or are you unable to see?

ayahs.arabicText: اِصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوْۤا اَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوْا١ۚ سَوَآءٌ عَلَیْكُمْ١ؕ اِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Go now and burn in it. It is all the same whether you bear it patiently or do not bear it with patience. You are only being recompensed for your deeds.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِیْنَ فِیْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّ نَعِیْمٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Surely the God-fearing shall be in Gardens and bliss,

ayahs.arabicText: فٰكِهِیْنَ بِمَاۤ اٰتٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ١ۚ وَ وَقٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: enjoying what Allah will have endowed them with; and their Lord will have saved them from the torment of the Blazing Fire.

ayahs.arabicText: كُلُوْا وَ اشْرَبُوْا هَنِیْٓئًۢا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: (They will be told): “Eat and drink to your hearts' content as a reward for your deeds.”

ayahs.arabicText: مُتَّكِئِیْنَ عَلٰى سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوْفَةٍ١ۚ وَ زَوَّجْنٰهُمْ بِحُوْرٍ عِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: The God-fearing shall be reclining on couches facing each other, and We shall wed them to maidens with large, beautiful eyes.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ اتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّیَّتُهُمْ بِاِیْمَانٍ اَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّیَّتَهُمْ وَ مَاۤ اَلَتْنٰهُمْ مِّنْ عَمَلِهِمْ مِّنْ شَیْءٍ١ؕ كُلُّ امْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: We shall unite the believers with those descendants of theirs who followed them in their faith, and shall not deny them any part of the reward for their good deeds. Every person is pledged to what he did.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَمْدَدْنٰهُمْ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَّ لَحْمٍ مِّمَّا یَشْتَهُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We shall provide them in abundance with all kinds of fruit and meat, whatever they may desire.

ayahs.arabicText: یَتَنَازَعُوْنَ فِیْهَا كَاْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِیْهَا وَ لَا تَاْثِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: They shall pass on to one another a cup that will incite neither levity nor sin.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَطُوْفُ عَلَیْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَاَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُوْنٌ
ayahs.translation: Youths as fair as hidden pearls will be set apart to wait upon them; they will be running to and fro to serve them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ یَّتَسَآءَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will turn to one another and ask (regarding the past events).

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِیْۤ اَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will say: “When we were living before among our kinsfolk we lived in constant fear (of Allah's displeasure).

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَیْنَا وَ وَقٰىنَا عَذَابَ السَّمُوْمِ
ayahs.translation: Then Allah graced us with His favour and saved us from the chastisement of the scorching wind.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا كُنَّا مِنْ قَبْلُ نَدْعُوْهُ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِیْمُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Formerly we had always prayed to Him. Surely He is Most Benign, Most Compassionate.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَاۤ اَنْتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَّ لَا مَجْنُوْنٍؕ
ayahs.translation: So exhort (them, O Prophet), for by your Lord's Grace, you are neither a soothsayer nor a madman.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهٖ رَیْبَ الْمَنُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: Or do they say: “He is a poet for whom we await an adverse turn of fortune.”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوْا فَاِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ مِّنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Tell them: “Wait; I too am waiting with you.”

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ تَاْمُرُهُمْ اَحْلَامُهُمْ بِهٰذَاۤ اَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Do their minds prompt them to say such things, or are they a people immersed in transgression?”

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ تَقَوَّلَهٗ١ۚ بَلْ لَّا یُؤْمِنُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Do they say: “He has himself fabricated the Qur'an?” No; the truth is that they are altogether averse to believing.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلْیَاْتُوْا بِحَدِیْثٍ مِّثْلِهٖۤ اِنْ كَانُوْا صٰدِقِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: (If they are truthful in this), then let them produce a discourse of similar splendour.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ خُلِقُوْا مِنْ غَیْرِ شَیْءٍ اَمْ هُمُ الْخٰلِقُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Did they come into being without any creator? Or were they their own creators?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ خَلَقُوا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ١ۚ بَلْ لَّا یُوْقِنُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Or is it they who created the heavens and the earth? No; the truth is that they lack sure faith.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ اَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَۜیْطِرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Or do they have your Lord's treasures in their keeping? Or have absolute authority over them?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ یَّسْتَمِعُوْنَ فِیْهِ١ۚ فَلْیَاْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُمْ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِیْنٍؕ
ayahs.translation: Or do they have a ladder whereon they can climb and attempt to listen (to what is transpiring in the Higher Realm)? Then, let any of them who has listened to it produce a clear proof of it.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ لَهُ الْبَنٰتُ وَ لَكُمُ الْبَنُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Or does Allah have daughters whereas you have sons?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ تَسْئَلُهُمْ اَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِّنْ مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Or is it that you ask of them any recompense so that they should fear to be weighed down under the burden of debt?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَیْبُ فَهُمْ یَكْتُبُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Or is it that they have access to (the Truths in) the realm beyond sense-perception which they are writing down?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یُرِیْدُوْنَ كَیْدًا١ؕ فَالَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا هُمُ الْمَكِیْدُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Or are they contriving a stratagem against you? If so, that stratagem will rebound against the unbelievers.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ لَهُمْ اِلٰهٌ غَیْرُ اللّٰهِ١ؕ سُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا یُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do they have any god other than Allah? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate (with Him in His Divinity).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ یَّرَوْا كِسْفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا یَّقُوْلُوْا سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُوْمٌ
ayahs.translation: (So obstinate are they that) even if they were to see some fragments of the sky falling down they would still say: “It is only a mass of cloud.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتّٰى یُلٰقُوْا یَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِیْ فِیْهِ یُصْعَقُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs when they shall be struck down,

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ لَا یُغْنِیْ عَنْهُمْ كَیْدُهُمْ شَیْئًا وَّ لَا هُمْ یُنْصَرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: when their stratagem shall be of no avail to them, nor shall they be succoured.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ لِلَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا عَذَابًا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَ وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely a chastisement awaits the wrong-doers even before the coming of that Day; but most of them do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَاِنَّكَ بِاَعْیُنِنَا وَ سَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِیْنَ تَقُوْمُۙ
ayahs.translation: Be patient, then, (O Prophet), until the judgement of your Lord comes. For surely you are before Our eyes. And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنَ الَّیْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَ اِدْبَارَ النُّجُوْمِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: and also celebrate His praise at night, and at the retreat of the stars.
